body.en: Domain Restrictions, Invertibility & Asymptotic Behavior: An algebraic or transcendental function \(f: D \to R\) possesses an inverse \(f^{-1}: R \to D\) if and only if \(f\) is strictly one-to-one (bijective) on \(D\), guaranteeing that \(\text{dom}(f^{-1}) = \text{ran}(f)\) and \(\text{ran}(f^{-1}) = \text{dom}(f)\). For logarithmic and radical equations, every algebraic step that squares both sides or combines logs (\(\log_b u + \log_b v = \log_b(uv)\)) can enlarge the solution set, requiring a final domain check against the original equation.
body.ar: Domain Restrictions, Invertibility & Asymptotic Behavior: An algebraic or transcendental الدالة \(f: D \to R\) possesses an inverse \(f^{-1}: R \to D\) if and only if \(f\) is strictly one-to-one (bijective) on \(D\), guaranteeing that \(\text{dom}(f^{-1}) = \text{ran}(f)\) and \(\text{ran}(f^{-1}) = \text{dom}(f)\). For logarithmic and radical المعادلات, every algebraic step that squares both sides or combines logs (\(\log_b u + \log_b v = \log_b(uv)\)) can enlarge the الحل set, requiring a final المجال check against the original المعادلة.

body.en:
Why Completing the Square & Log-Linearization Work: Any quadratic \(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c\) (\(a \ne 0\)) can be rewritten by factoring \(a\) from the first two terms and adding/subtracting \((b/2a)^2\):

\[ ax^2 + bx + c = a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \]

Because \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 \ge 0\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), the extreme value \(k = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\) is attained uniquely at the axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\), restricting the range to \([k, \infty)\) (if \(a > 0\)) and making \(f\) invertible on \(x \ge -\frac{b}{2a}\). Similarly, applying \(\ln\) to power laws \(y = ax^n\) yields \(\ln y = n\ln x + \ln a\), transforming a nonlinear curve into a straight line of gradient \(n\).
body.ar:
Why Completing the Square & Log-Linearization Work: Any quadratic \(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c\) (\(a \ne 0\)) can be rewritten by factoring \(a\) from the first two terms and adding/subtracting \((b/2a)^2\):

\[ ax^2 + bx + c = a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \]

Because \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 \ge 0\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), the extreme value \(k = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\) is attained uniquely at the axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\), restricting the المدى to \([k, \infty)\) (if \(a > 0\)) and making \(f\) invertible on \(x \ge -\frac{b}{2a}\). Similarly, applying \(\ln\) to power laws \(y = ax^n\) yields \(\ln y = n\ln x + \ln a\), transforming a nonlinear curve into a straight line of gradient \(n\).

body.en:
Combine into a single rational expression: \( \dfrac{3}{x - 2} + \dfrac{2}{x + 1} \).

The common denominator is \( (x - 2)(x + 1) \):

\[ \frac{3(x + 1) + 2(x - 2)}{(x - 2)(x + 1)} = \frac{3x + 3 + 2x - 4}{(x - 2)(x + 1)} = \frac{5x - 1}{(x - 2)(x + 1)}, \quad x \neq 2, -1. \]
body.ar:
Combine into a single rational العبارة الجبرية: \( \dfrac{3}{x - 2} + \dfrac{2}{x + 1} \).

The common denominator is \( (x - 2)(x + 1) \):

\[ \frac{3(x + 1) + 2(x - 2)}{(x - 2)(x + 1)} = \frac{3x + 3 + 2x - 4}{(x - 2)(x + 1)} = \frac{5x - 1}{(x - 2)(x + 1)}, \quad x \neq 2, -1. \]

body.en: The single most common error in algebra is the illegal cancellation trap: in \( \dfrac{x + 5}{x} \), you cannot cancel the \( x \)'s to get \( 5 \)! You can only divide out common multiplicative factors, never additive terms. Always factor both numerator and denominator completely into products before cancelling.
body.ar: The single most common error in الجبر is the illegal cancellation trap: in \( \dfrac{x + 5}{x} \), you cannot cancel the \( x \)'s to get \( 5 \)! You can only divide out common multiplicative factors, never additive terms. Always factor both numerator and denominator completely into products before cancelling.

body.en:
Problem (Hard): What is the sum of all distinct real solutions to the equation \[ \frac{x}{x^2 + 4} + \frac{x}{x^2 - 3x + 4} = \frac{1}{2}\,? \]

Step-by-Step Solution: To solve the equation, we first test if \(x = 0\) is a solution: \[ \frac{0}{0^2 + 4} + \frac{0}{0^2 - 3(0) + 4} = 0 \neq \frac{1}{2} \] Thus, \(x \neq 0\). Since \(x \neq 0\), we divide the numerator and denominator of each rational expression by \(x\): \[ \frac{1}{x + \frac{4}{x}} + \frac{1}{x - 3 + \frac{4}{x}} = \frac{1}{2} \] Notice that the common algebraic structure \(u = x + \frac{4}{x}\) appears in both denominators. Substituting \(u\) yields: \[ \frac{1}{u} + \frac{1}{u - 3} = \frac{1}{2} \] Multiplying both sides by the common denominator \(2u(u - 3)\) (where \(u \neq 0, 3\)): \[ 2(u - 3) + 2u = u(u - 3) \] \[ 4u - 6 = u^2 - 3u \implies u^2 - 7u + 6 = 0 \] Factoring gives: \[ (u - 1)(u - 6) = 0 \implies u = 1 \quad \text{or} \quad u = 6 \] Now, substitute back \(u = x + \frac{4}{x}\): 1. Case 1: \(x + \frac{4}{x} = 1\) \[ x^2 - x + 4 = 0 \] The discriminant is \(\Delta_1 = (-1)^2 - 4(1)(4) = 1 - 16 = -15 < 0\). Therefore, this case yields no real solutions. 2. Case 2: \(x + \frac{4}{x} = 6\) \[ x^2 - 6x + 4 = 0 \] The discriminant is \(\Delta_2 = (-6)^2 - 4(1)(4) = 36 - 16 = 20 > 0\). This yields two distinct real solutions: \[ x = \frac{6 \pm \sqrt{20}}{2} = 3 \pm \sqrt{5} \] Both denominators in the original equation are positive for all real \(x\) (since \(x^2 + 4 > 0\) and \(x^2 - 3x + 4\) has discriminant \(-7 < 0\)), so neither solution is extraneous. The sum of all distinct real solutions is: \[ (3 + \sqrt{5}) + (3 - \sqrt{5}) = 6 \] *Common Misconception:* Clearing denominators directly gives the quartic polynomial \(x^4 - 7x^3 + 14x^2 - 28x + 16 = 0\). Applying Vieta's formulas blindly gives a root sum of \(-(-7)/1 = 7\). However, this includes the two non-real complex roots from \(x^2 - x + 4 = 0\), making \(7\) incorrect.
body.ar:
Problem (Hard): What is the sum of all distinct real الحلول to the المعادلة \[ \frac{x}{x^2 + 4} + \frac{x}{x^2 - 3x + 4} = \frac{1}{2}\,? \]

Step-by-Step الحل: To حل المعادلة, we first test if \(x = 0\) is a الحل: \[ \frac{0}{0^2 + 4} + \frac{0}{0^2 - 3(0) + 4} = 0 \neq \frac{1}{2} \] وعليه, \(x \neq 0\). Since \(x \neq 0\), we divide the numerator and denominator of each rational العبارة الجبرية by \(x\): \[ \frac{1}{x + \frac{4}{x}} + \frac{1}{x - 3 + \frac{4}{x}} = \frac{1}{2} \] Notice that the common algebraic structure \(u = x + \frac{4}{x}\) appears in both denominators. Substituting \(u\) yields: \[ \frac{1}{u} + \frac{1}{u - 3} = \frac{1}{2} \] Multiplying both sides by the common denominator \(2u(u - 3)\) (حيث \(u \neq 0, 3\)): \[ 2(u - 3) + 2u = u(u - 3) \] \[ 4u - 6 = u^2 - 3u \implies u^2 - 7u + 6 = 0 \] Factoring gives: \[ (u - 1)(u - 6) = 0 \implies u = 1 \quad \text{or} \quad u = 6 \] Now, عوّض back \(u = x + \frac{4}{x}\): 1. Case 1: \(x + \frac{4}{x} = 1\) \[ x^2 - x + 4 = 0 \] The discriminant is \(\Delta_1 = (-1)^2 - 4(1)(4) = 1 - 16 = -15 < 0\). وبالتالي, this case yields no real الحلول. 2. Case 2: \(x + \frac{4}{x} = 6\) \[ x^2 - 6x + 4 = 0 \] The discriminant is \(\Delta_2 = (-6)^2 - 4(1)(4) = 36 - 16 = 20 > 0\). This yields two distinct real الحلول: \[ x = \frac{6 \pm \sqrt{20}}{2} = 3 \pm \sqrt{5} \] Both denominators in the original المعادلة are positive for all real \(x\) (since \(x^2 + 4 > 0\) and \(x^2 - 3x + 4\) has discriminant \(-7 < 0\)), so neither الحل is extraneous. The sum of all distinct real الحلول is: \[ (3 + \sqrt{5}) + (3 - \sqrt{5}) = 6 \] *Common Misconception:* Clearing denominators directly gives the quartic كثيرة الحدود \(x^4 - 7x^3 + 14x^2 - 28x + 16 = 0\). Applying Vieta's الصيغ blindly gives a root sum of \(-(-7)/1 = 7\). However, this includes the two non-real complex roots from \(x^2 - x + 4 = 0\), making \(7\) incorrect.

body.en:
Problem (Easy): Which of the following is equivalent to the expression \(\frac{5}{x} + \frac{2}{3x}\) for all \(x \neq 0\)?

Step-by-Step Solution: To add the rational expressions, first find a common denominator. The least common denominator of \(x\) and \(3x\) is \(3x\). Rewrite \(\frac{5}{x}\) with the denominator \(3x\) by multiplying both the numerator and denominator by 3: \[ \frac{5 \cdot 3}{x \cdot 3} = \frac{15}{3x} \] Now add the two expressions with the common denominator: \[ \frac{15}{3x} + \frac{2}{3x} = \frac{15 + 2}{3x} = \frac{17}{3x} \] Common Misconceptions: - Choice B (\(\frac{7}{4x}\)) results from incorrectly adding both the numerators and denominators directly: \(\frac{5+2}{x+3x}\). - Choice C (\(\frac{7}{3x}\)) results from adding the numerators without first finding an equivalent fraction with the common denominator: \(\frac{5+2}{3x}\). - Choice D (\(\frac{10}{3x^2}\)) results from multiplying the expressions rather than adding them.
body.ar:
Problem (Easy): Which of the following is equivalent to the العبارة الجبرية \(\frac{5}{x} + \frac{2}{3x}\) for all \(x \neq 0\)?

Step-by-Step الحل: To add the rational expressions, first find a common denominator. The least common denominator of \(x\) and \(3x\) is \(3x\). Rewrite \(\frac{5}{x}\) with the denominator \(3x\) by multiplying both the numerator and denominator by 3: \[ \frac{5 \cdot 3}{x \cdot 3} = \frac{15}{3x} \] Now add the two expressions with the common denominator: \[ \frac{15}{3x} + \frac{2}{3x} = \frac{15 + 2}{3x} = \frac{17}{3x} \] Common Misconceptions: - Choice B (\(\frac{7}{4x}\)) results from incorrectly adding both the numerators and denominators directly: \(\frac{5+2}{x+3x}\). - Choice C (\(\frac{7}{3x}\)) results from adding the numerators without first finding an equivalent fraction with the common denominator: \(\frac{5+2}{3x}\). - Choice D (\(\frac{10}{3x^2}\)) results from multiplying the expressions rather than adding them.

body.en: Fast Exam Check (Honors Algebra 1 & Foundations): To verify an inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) in 5 seconds, pick a simple input \(x_0\), compute \(y_0 = f(x_0)\), and check that \(f^{-1}(y_0) = x_0\). Also verify that the graph of \(y = f^{-1}(x)\) reflects \(y = f(x)\) across \(y = x\).

Also verify that the التمثيل البياني of \(y = f^{-1}(x)\) reflects \(y = f(x)\) across \(y = x\).

solution.en:
Factor the denominator on the RHS: \( x^2 - 2x - 3 = (x - 3)(x + 1) \). The LCD is \( (x - 3)(x + 1) \). Note the domain restriction: \( x eq 3 \) and \( x eq -1 \).

Multiply every term by the LCD:

\[ x(x + 1) - 2(x - 3) = 6 \implies x^2 + x - 2x + 6 = 6. \]

Simplify and solve:

\[ x^2 - x = 0 \implies x(x - 1) = 0 \implies x = 0 \quad \text{or} \quad x = 1. \]

Both values are within the allowed domain (neither equals 3 or -1). The solutions are \( x = 0 \) and \( x = 1 \).

question.en: Simplify the complex rational expression: \(\dfrac{\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{y}}{\frac{1}{x^2} - \frac{1}{y^2}}\), where \(x \neq y\) and \(xy \neq 0\).
question.ar: بسّط العبارة the complex rational expression: \(\dfrac{\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{y}}{\frac{1}{x^2} - \frac{1}{y^2}}\), حيث \(x \neq y\) and \(xy \neq 0\).

solution.en:
Factor the denominator as a difference of squares:

\[\frac{1}{x^2} - \frac{1}{y^2} = \left(\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{y}\right)\left(\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y}\right).\]

Cancel the common factor \(\left(\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{y}\right)\):

\[\frac{1}{\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y}} = \frac{1}{\frac{y + x}{xy}} = \frac{xy}{x + y}.\]
solution.ar:
حلّل the denominator as a dإذا كانference of squares:

\[\frac{1}{x^2} - \frac{1}{y^2} = \left(\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{y}\right)\left(\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y}\right).\]

Cancel the common حلّل \(\left(\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{y}\right)\):

\[\frac{1}{\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y}} = \frac{1}{\frac{y + x}{xy}} = \frac{xy}{x + y}.\]

question.en: [Practice 3 · Medium] The rational expression \(\frac{2x^2 + ax - 7}{x + 4}\) is equivalent to \(2x + b + \frac{5}{x + 4}\) for all \(x \neq -4\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are constants. What is the value of \(a + b\)?
question.ar: [Practice 3 · Medium] The rational expression \(\frac{2x^2 + ax - 7}{x + 4}\) is equivalent to \(2x + b + \frac{5}{x + 4}\) for all \(x \neq -4\), حيث \(a\) and \(b\) are constants. ما قيمة \(a + b\)?

hints.en: To find the values of \(a\) and \(b\), equate the two expressions: \(\frac{2x^2 + ax - 7}{x + 4} = 2x + b + \frac{5}{x + 4}\).
hints.ar: To أوجد values of \(a\) and \(b\), equate the two expressions: \(\frac{2x^2 + ax - 7}{x + 4} = 2x + b + \frac{5}{x + 4}\).

hints.en: Multiplying both sides by the common denominator \(x + 4\): \(2x^2 + ax - 7 = (2x + b)(x + 4) + 5\) Expand the right side: \((2x + b)(x + 4) + 5 = 2x^2 + 8x + bx + 4b + 5 = 2x^2 + (b + 8)x + (4b + 5)\).
hints.ar: Multiplying both sides بتطبيق common denominator \(x + 4\): \(2x^2 + ax - 7 = (2x + b)(x + 4) + 5\) فكّ المقدار the right side: \((2x + b)(x + 4) + 5 = 2x^2 + 8x + bx + 4b + 5 = 2x^2 + (b + 8)x + (4b + 5)\).

solution.en:
To find the values of \(a\) and \(b\), equate the two expressions:
\[
\frac{2x^2 + ax - 7}{x + 4} = 2x + b + \frac{5}{x + 4}
\]
Multiplying both sides by the common denominator \(x + 4\):
\[
2x^2 + ax - 7 = (2x + b)(x + 4) + 5
\]
Expand the right side:
\[
(2x + b)(x + 4) + 5 = 2x^2 + 8x + bx + 4b + 5 = 2x^2 + (b + 8)x + (4b + 5)
\]
Equating coefficients of corresponding powers of \(x\) on both sides:
1. Constant terms: \(-7 = 4b + 5 \implies 4b = -12 \implies b = -3\).
2. Linear coefficients: \(a = b + 8 \implies a = -3 + 8 = 5\).

Finally, calculate \(a + b\):
\[
a + b = 5 + (-3) = 2
\]

- Choice A (\(-1\)) arises from an arithmetic error in solving for \(a\).
- Choice C (\(5\)) is the value of \(a\) alone.
- Choice D (\(8\)) is the value of \(a - b = 5 - (-3) = 8\).
solution.ar:
To أوجد values of \(a\) and \(b\), equate the two expressions:
\[
\frac{2x^2 + ax - 7}{x + 4} = 2x + b + \frac{5}{x + 4}
\]
Multiplying both sides بتطبيق common denominator \(x + 4\):
\[
2x^2 + ax - 7 = (2x + b)(x + 4) + 5
\]
فكّ المقدار the right side:
\[
(2x + b)(x + 4) + 5 = 2x^2 + 8x + bx + 4b + 5 = 2x^2 + (b + 8)x + (4b + 5)
\]
Equating coefficients of corresponding powers of \(x\) on both sides:
1. Constant terms: \(-7 = 4b + 5 \implies 4b = -12 \implies b = -3\).
2. Linear coefficients: \(a = b + 8 \implies a = -3 + 8 = 5\).

Finally, احسب \(a + b\):
\[
a + b = 5 + (-3) = 2
\]

- Choice A (\(-1\)) arises from an arithmetic error in solving for \(a\).
- Choice C (\(5\)) is the value of \(a\) alone.
- Choice D (\(8\)) is the value of \(a - b = 5 - (-3) = 8\).

question.en: [Practice 4 · Hard] Which of the following expressions is equivalent to \(\frac{x^2 - 4}{x - 2}\) for all values of \(x\) where the expression is defined?
question.ar: [Practice 4 · Hard] Which of the following expressions is equivalent to \(\frac{x^2 - 4}{x - 2}\) for all values of \(x\) حيث the expression is defined?

hints.en: The expression \(\frac{x^2 - 4}{x - 2}\) can be simplified by factoring the numerator.
hints.ar: The expression \(\frac{x^2 - 4}{x - 2}\) can be simplإذا كانied by حلّلing the numerator.

hints.en: The numerator \(x^2 - 4\) is a difference of squares, which factors as \((x - 2)(x + 2)\). Therefore, the expression becomes \(\frac{(x - 2)(x + 2)}{x - 2}\).
hints.ar: The numerator \(x^2 - 4\) is a dإذا كانference of squares, which حلّلs as \((x - 2)(x + 2)\). وبالتالي، the expression becomes \(\frac{(x - 2)(x + 2)}{x - 2}\).
تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(x + 2\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

solution.en:
The expression \(\frac{x^2 - 4}{x - 2}\) can be simplified by factoring the numerator. The numerator \(x^2 - 4\) is a difference of squares, which factors as \((x - 2)(x + 2)\). Therefore, the expression becomes \(\frac{(x - 2)(x + 2)}{x - 2}\). For all values of \(x\) where \(x
eq 2\) (so that the denominator is not zero), we can cancel out the common factor \((x - 2)\) from the numerator and the denominator. This leaves us with \(x + 2\).

eq 2\) (so that the denominator is not zero), we can cancel out the common حلّل \((x - 2)\) from the numerator and the denominator. This leaves us with \(x + 2\).

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)
النسبية (المقلوب)\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) وتقارب أفقي \(y = k\)
الأسية\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)تقارب أفقي \(y = k\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, a+k)\)
اللوغاريتمية\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h+1, k)\)
